description: What test_real_adapter_harness_probe.py measured on each pinned harness. Every check asserts the run matches its entry EXACTLY, then marks itself xfail where the entry records a known defect. A change that moves a measurement updates this file in the same PR. literal / expansion cells: Y = the server started with the real value, L = with the literal reference, 0 = without the variable, - = never started. ambient: the harness's own user/project config servers that started in the Crew session. crew_tool_bytes_ceiling: the most bytes of Crew's own tool specs one model request may carry on that harness; above crew_tool_bytes_target the ceiling is today's measurement plus headroom, held until deferral lands.

claude.note: claude-agent-acp 0.94.0 (agent SDK 0.3.303) sends Crew's tool specs in full to the loopback model, about 127 KB; 0.100.0 (agent SDK 0.3.316) deferred them behind ToolSearch in the same setup. Re-measure on the bump.
